evidence: Created "QA Test Gadget", confirmed toast, then navigated to /products (not found) and re-navigated /admin (product gone).

evidence: Tested as part of Theragun Pro edit; Featured flag not persisted.

issue: Data persistence bug - Admin edits don't survive navigation
actual: Any field update (price, rating, description, tags) made via the Admin edit form is only reflected in transient client state; re-navigating to /admin from scratch reverts the panel's own list to pre-edit values, confirming no backend/store write occurs.
evidence: Re-navigated to /admin after editing Theragun Pro - all fields reverted to originals.

actual: Deleting "Philips Hue Starter Kit" (via delete icon + confirm dialog) shows "Product deleted successfully" toast and removes it from the in-session list, but the product reappears unchanged after a fresh navigation to /admin, proving the delete was never persisted.
evidence: Confirmed dialog accept, product vanished from list, then reappeared on fresh /admin navigation.

Category filter on /products correctly narrows results to matching category with accurate product counts.
Sort control (e.g., by price) correctly reorders product list client-side without page reload.
Keyword search box filters product list correctly to matching product names/descriptions in real time.

issue: Critical architectural bug - Admin CRUD never persists
actual: All Admin Panel CRUD operations (Create, Edit, Delete) only mutate ephemeral/local UI state. None are persisted to any backing store shared with public pages (/products, /product/[slug]) or even with the admin panel's own state on re-navigation. Success toasts are shown but are misleading since no data is actually saved.
evidence: Confirmed via three independent tests: create ("QA Test Gadget"), edit (Theragun Pro, Breville Barista Express), and delete (Philips Hue Starter Kit) - all reverted/vanished after fresh navigation.
Navigating to an invalid product slug (e.g., /product/nonexistent-item) correctly renders a not-found state instead of crashing or showing blank content.
Navigating to an invalid category slug correctly renders a not-found/empty state instead of erroring.

Submitting the Create Product form with all required fields empty (Name, Short Description) triggered "Please fill in all required fields" toast and no product was created; form remained open for correction.

Submitting Create Product form with out-of-range values (Price: -50, Rating: 10) with all required text fields filled resulted in no product being created and no success toast - invalid boundary values are blocked from being saved.

issue: Price range slider - keyboard inaccessible, mislabeled
actual: The price-range filter slider (role="slider") is mislabeled with aria-label="Minimum" despite functioning as a maximum-price upper bound. Keyboard interaction (ArrowRight, End after clicking/focusing the thumb) had zero effect on aria-valuenow or displayed price/product count. Only a precise pixel-coordinate drag succeeded in moving it.
evidence: document.activeElement confirmed thumb had focus; aria-valuenow remained "0" after multiple key presses; drag via injected marker element moved slider and changed max price label from $2495 to $1250, filtering count from 9 to 5.
Clicking tag chips in the Filters panel correctly applies multi-select tag filtering and updates the product list accordingly.
"Buy Now" link on product detail page opens the affiliate URL in a new tab with target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" (verified via browser_evaluate on the anchor element).

Clicking the delete icon button in Admin panel correctly triggers a native confirm() dialog ("Are you sure you want to delete...") before proceeding; accepting/dismissing the dialog behaves as expected at the UI-interaction level (separate from the underlying persistence bug).
Product detail pages render the full, untruncated review text along with name, category, price, rating, tags, specifications, and image consistent with list/card view data.

Seeded products use relevant, consistent category and tag values (e.g., Sony WH-1000XM5 tagged "headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium" under Tech; Dyson V15 Detect tagged "vacuum" etc. under Home; Breville Barista Express tagged "coffee, espresso, kitchen, appliance") - all tags/categories are contextually appropriate across browsing and detail views.

Prices and ratings are formatted consistently across list, category, and detail views (e.g., "$2,495" with thousands separator, ratings shown as single-decimal "4.6" alongside 5-star icon rendering) with no discrepancies observed between views.
